title: Linkwright — Mechanism Workshop
description: Design four-bar linkages, meshed gear trains and cam profiles, watch them run, then export real millimetre SVG.
concept: Three kinematics benches in one page. The linkage bench solves a four-bar or slider-crank chain at every crank angle, classifies it by the Grashof criterion, and traces the curve your draggable coupler point sweeps out — load Hoeken's linkage and watch it draw a straight line out of nothing but pin joints. The gear bench builds spur trains whose teeth genuinely mesh, because each gear's phase is solved from the line of centres rather than animated independently. The cam bench composes a profile out of rise, dwell and fall segments with real motion laws, plots the follower's displacement, velocity and acceleration, and exports the cut outline in millimetres.
features: Linkage bench: four-bar and slider-crank chains, eight named presets, Grashof classification and live transmission angle
Draggable tracer point that redraws the coupler curve as you move it, plus ghost poses across the whole sweep
Gear bench: build a train of up to six spur gears, drag any gear around its neighbour, read ratio, output rpm and torque gain
Cam bench: add, remove and retype profile segments across four motion laws with a live s/v/a plot
Export the active bench as millimetre-accurate SVG ready to cut, or as a PNG snapshot
Save the design as JSON, reload it from file, or copy a share link that encodes the whole workshop in the URL
localStorage autosave, keyboard control (1/2/3, space, arrows) and touch dragging on every bench

interaction.mouse: Drag the purple tracer point P to reshape the coupler curve; drag crank pin B to scrub the mechanism; drag any gear to swing it around its neighbour; drag the cam to rotate it.
interaction.click: Switch benches with the segmented control, load a preset, add or remove gears and cam segments, and export SVG / PNG / JSON.
interaction.touch: Every drag target works with touch; the panel becomes a scrolling sheet below the stage on narrow screens.
interaction.keyboard: 1/2/3 switch benches, space plays and pauses, arrow keys step the drive angle (shift for a bigger step), F refits the view.
